newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Bahrain stocks drop slightly in week.
newsitem.headline: Bahrain stocks drop slightly in week.

text.p: Bahrain's share index dropped slightly this week in trade focused on bank and investment shares, the Bahrain Stock Exchange said.
It said the index dropped 6.56 points to 1,488.10 points in the week ending on Thursday from 1,494.66 points last week.
Trading volume rose to 7.3 million shares worth 1.6 million dinars ($4.2 million) from 1.6 million shares worth 429,450 dinars the previous close.
Shares of 25 companies were traded in 154 transactions.
Al-Ahli Commercial Bank shares dominated the market in terms of value traded with more than 1.4 million shares worth 454,219 dinars changing hands. It closed at 330 fils on Thursday.
Bahrain's bourse is open to nationals of the six Gulf Arab states - Saudi Arabia, Oman, Qatar, Bahrain, the United Arab Emirates and Kuwait.
